gripOrHq.title: Imp
gripOrHq.rulesText: Imp can have up to 2 MU of programs installed in it. All icebreakers installed in this way have their strength reduced by 1. If IMP leaves play, trash all programs installed in it.

gripOrHq.title: Broker
gripOrHq.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

gripOrHq.rulesText: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterwards.

gripOrHq.title: Sneak Preview
gripOrHq.rulesText: Choose a program from your trash or search your stack for a program. Install that program, at no cost. Shuffle your stack afterwards. At the end of the turn, take the program into your hand.

gripOrHq.title: Short-Term Contract
gripOrHq.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Short-Term Contract when it is installed. When all the bits have been removed, trash Short-Term Contract. A: Take [2] from Short-Term Contract.

scoreArea.title: Please Don't Choke Anyone
scoreArea.rulesText: For each 1 damage you successfully do, you may choose instead to prevent that damage and put a PDCA counter on Please Don't Choke Anyone. PDCA counter: Gain an action. Use this ability only once per turn and only during your turn.

scoreArea.title: Project Zurich
scoreArea.rulesText: For every two advancement counters over Project Zurich 's difficulty that are on Project Zurich when you score it, gain 1 at the start of each of your turns.

2 credits: +1 strength.

rig.title: Snowball
rig.rulesText:
Snowball has +1 strength for each subroutine it has broken during a run, until the end of that run.
[1]: Break sentry subroutine.

rig.title: Afreet
rig.rulesText: Afreet can host up to 3 MU of programs. Hosted programs use Afreet's hosting capacity instead of Runner MU. All icebreakers hosted on Afreet have their strength reduced by 1. If Afreet leaves play, trash all programs hosted on it.

rig.title: “Armadillo” Armored Road Home
rig.rulesText: Put [2] from the bank on Armored Road Home when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for removing tags. If you use any of these bits, replace them from the bank at the start of your next turn. [T]: Prevent up to 3 meat damage.

rig.title: Smith's Pawnshop
rig.rulesText:
At the start of each of your turns, you may trash one of your other installed cards to gain [2].
Only one unique card of a particular name can be in play at a time. If for some reason more than one is in play, trash all but one.

rig.title: The Shell Traders
rig.rulesText: A: Choose a program or hardware card from your hand. Set that card aside face up, and put a number of Shell counters on it equal to its installation cost. When the last Shell counter on that card has been removed, install that card, at no cost. Remove one Shell counter from one card at the start of each of your turns. [1]: Remove one Shell counter from a card.

ice.title: Bug Zapper
ice.rulesText: *Do 2 Net damage for each rezzed piece of ice installed outside Bug Zapper. *End the run.

root.title: Lesley Major
root.rulesText: Install Lesley Major only in a subsidiary data fort. [5]: Add two advancement counters, at no cost, to a card installed in this data fort. Use this ability only when Runner passes the last piece of ice on this fort, and only once per run.

root.title: Emergency Rig
root.rulesText: Rez a piece of ice, at no cost. Put X Kludge counters on that piece of ice; X cannot be 0. At the start of each of your turns, remove a Kludge counter. Trash that piece of ice when the last Kludge counter is removed from it.

root.title: Minotaur
root.rulesText: For each rezzed code gate or wall installed outside Minotaur, Minotaur has one "*End the run" subroutine.

root.title: Hunting Pack
root.rulesText: For each rezzed piece of ice installed outside Hunting Pack, Hunting Pack has one subroutine as follows: "*Trace 5-If trace is successful, give Runner a tag."

root.title: Minotaur
root.rulesText: For each rezzed code gate or wall installed outside Minotaur, Minotaur has one "*End the run" subroutine.

root.title: Dog Pile
root.rulesText: *Do 1 Net damage for each rezzed piece of ice installed outside Dog Pile. *End the run. Dog Pile has +1 strength for each rezzed piece of ice installed outside it.

root.title: Homing Missile
root.rulesText: *Trace x-If trace is successful, end the run, and Runner cannot make another run until Runner takes an action to pay [2]. Pay X, above the rez cost, when you rez Homing Missile. X is Homing Missile 's strength and trace limit, and X cannot be greater than 8.

ice.title: Walking Wall
ice.rulesText: *End the run. [1]: Move Walking Wall and insert it in a different position on this data fort. Use this ability only at the start of a run on this data fort. You may use this ability even if Walking Wall is unrezzed, in which case, you reveal it.

ice.rulesText: *End the run. When you rez Caryatid, you may pay [1], above the rez cost, to make it a code gate instead of a wall.

removedFromGame.title: MIT West Tier
removedFromGame.rulesText: Shuffle your hand, trash, and stack together, and then draw five cards. When you play MIT West Tier, remove it from the game instead of trashing it.
